mastering.q: Using collision theory, explain fully why raising the temperature of a reacting mixture by 10 degrees Celsius can roughly double the rate of reaction, and explain why a catalyst has a different effect on the same mixture.
mastering.a: Higher temperature gives particles more kinetic energy, so collisions are more frequent and a far greater proportion exceed the activation energy. A catalyst does not change particle energy, it provides an alternative pathway with a lower activation energy, so more collisions succeed at the same temperature.
